g.text: 1. Terrace slab shown 150mm thick, assumed equal to the top floor slab: the model has no storey above the terrace
2. Stair is a dogleg: the model stores one origin, direction and landing, so the section shows the first flight
(8 of 16 risers, +1504) and the landing. The return flight is not drawn.
3. Stair is a dogleg: the model stores one origin, direction and landing, so the section shows the first flight
(8 of 16 risers, +1504) and the landing. The return flight is not drawn.
4. Foundation line is indicative only, 900mm below plinth level (-300): INDICATIVE — REFER STRUCTURAL.
